strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
So they've come... those Holy Warriors.
Shot, can the Wil Wiph not launch!?
...No, sir. The damage to the aura converter was worse than expected,
so replacing it will take several more days...
...Blast it, unable to launch when it's needed most...!
So you've come... Show Zama. I slipped at Castle Uroporos... but this time...!
Well, well, aren't you fired up.
Hey, Captain, push too hard and you'll blow it again.
Hahaha!
He blows it whether he pushes hard or not, doesn't he?
...You two...!
What are you doing? The enemy is right in front of you!
Fine, fine. Guess we'll get going, then.
Lord Shot... I'm heading out...
Please, don't push yourself too hard, Musie.
Whew, they sure rounded up a lot of 'em.
I'm starting to get nervous.
If you lose in spirit, it's over...! Think about pushing forward!
Hot-blooded as ever, Lieutenant. But yeah, we've got no choice...!
We can't count on resupply... Fight while conserving energy.
Close in with Getter-2, finish with Getter-1... That's all we can do.
...If only they'd come into the water.
Doesn't look like they're up for that.
Besides, if an Aura Battler dove in, it'd probably spring a leak.
Here they come!
Don't let them surround us, and take them out one by one. Let's go...!
Surface dwellers who defy me... I'll crush you...! Commence the attack!
Reinforcements!?
We've come this far and there's still more!?
Show, no! That's...!
Show Zama! Holy Warrior, are you safe?
That's... the battleship that was under construction back then!?
Lady Sheela's Gran Garan... It made it in time.
Thanks to the surface people, Drake's army couldn't interfere
with the Gran Garan's construction.
It should put a lot of pressure on the enemy. We can win this...!
Nngh, that's Na's battleship...!? Sheela Lapana has made her move!?
Perfect! The enemy's rattled, Show!
Wow! Lady Sheela! Over here, over here!
Heh, she looks all gentle, but she comes through when it counts.
All right, let's go all out!
Wow... What a lovely battleship. It's like a castle.
Really, it's got a totally different style from surface battleships.
Huh~? A battleship's gotta look, like, way tougher than that.
This is no time to gawk! Focus!
Geez, what now!? ...Wait, ah, aah, Show! This is bad, Show!
No way!? That light just now?
Aura... Light...
That's...!?
Alchemie...!
So here is where you were... Kyosuke...
Was it...you? Did you open the Aura Road and send us here...?
That's right...
Why on earth would you do that...?
Ufufufu...
That enemy can open the Aura Road at will?
Then how about sending us back to our own world!
I'm afraid I can't do that.
This light... Then it is from the surface!?
...Aura... Power......
...How convenient... Kyosuke and the others can lend a hand...
Lend a hand? What do you mean?
That's...my business...
(This one...)
Looks like we've got no choice but to fight either way.
We'll catch you and make you send us back to the surface!
Will it really go that smoothly...?
Still, it's one of our few chances of getting back. We can't ignore it.
(...It's not just about getting back to the surface...
I'm going to find out what you are...!)
Kyosuke... Kyosuke... What are you...?
That's my line.
I want to know...more about you... What you...are.
...What's that supposed to mean...?
You're the one who disturbs me.
(What is it getting at...?)
Dangerous... you are...
How about giving up already and sending us back to the surface?
...Very well... Shall we go back?
What!?
I'm already done with this place...
Done!? What... What are you after!?
What's your goal!?
Well then, goodbye... Kyosuke...
Lady Elle? Is something wrong?
...A white...machine... coming through the Aura Road...
A white machine?
White... Hey, you don't mean...!?
Huh? No way!
Tobikage!?
That robot can cross dimensions too!?
Or did it follow that skeletal robot here?
What...is that?
It's an ally, Lady Sheela!
Tobikage~! Go for it!
Showing up right at the best part.
We can't let it outdo us! Let's go, Hayato! Benkei!
Come to think of it, this ninja robot's a mystery too... Who's behind it...?
Who cares right now! Tobikage, we're counting on you...!
Hey~, take us with you!
They went back without us!
No...
Wh-what is this feeling!?
C-could it be...!?
Lady Elle!
...Do not worry. The surface people have only returned to their world...
Show... Marvel...
Lady Elle... With our current forces, defeating Drake would be difficult...
Indeed. Let us withdraw for now...
What? After we cornered Drake this far!
Keen, we've done enough for now.
Don't forget we got this far thanks to the surface people.
Lady Sheela!
...Do not worry. The surface people have only returned to their world...
Show... Marvel...
Nie! The Ferario are gone too!
They must have been drawn in by the surface people's Aura Power...
Lady Elle... With our current forces, defeating Drake would be difficult...
Lady Sheela... For now, we should...
Yes, it seems that's all we can do...
What? After we cornered Drake this far!
Keen, we've done enough for now.
Don't forget we got this far thanks to the surface people.
